name: Arbitrum One
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: According to the block explorer, the last block of the Arbitrum One network was generated at 18:29 Beijing time, and no new blocks and new transactions have been generated for more than 2 hours. At the same time, the Matemask wallet cannot connect to the Arbitrum One network.
